<STRUCT_0001>
We often single out a category <MATH_0001> of algebraic spaces over <MATH_0002>
by some separation axiom, see
Example <REF_0001>
for some standard cases.
Note that <MATH_0003> is a categorical quotient if and only
if <MATH_0004> is a coequalizer for the
morphisms <MATH_0005> in the category. Hence we immediately
deduce the following lemma.

units.source_text:
Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme, and let <MATH_0002> be an algebraic space over <MATH_0003>.
Let <MATH_0004> be a pre-relation in algebraic spaces over <MATH_0005>.
If a categorical quotient in the category of algebraic spaces
over <MATH_0006> exists, then it is unique up to unique isomorphism.
Similarly for categorical quotients in full subcategories of
<MATH_0007>.
